en: A multiview tourist postcard showing mountain resorts, hotels, alpine scenery and the famous Neo‑Renaissance Peleș Castle in the center image. The title on the front reads "VALEA PRAHOVEI" in red, indicating the Prahova Valley in the Carpathian Mountains of Romania. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a red POSTA ROMANA 55 BANI stamp, and printed multilingual captions.
